HOLIDAYS.note: serial 1 (1899) = inactive/blank; keeps NETWORKDAYS holiday range numeric

LEAVE_BALANCES.note: amount the accrual job posts as an ACCRUAL transaction

LEAVE_APPLICATIONS.note: available balance excluding this application own pending hold

ATTENDANCE_EVENTS.note: same employee + type within DUPLICATE_WINDOW_SEC of an earlier punch
IN->OUT pairing: minutes between an OUT and the latest earlier valid IN that has no OUT in between
IN uses the day-boundary rule; a paired OUT inherits its IN work date, so night / cross-midnight shifts stay on one day
Google Maps link for the punch location, built from geo_lat / geo_lng

ATTENDANCE_DAILY.note: adjusted: span minus break; otherwise IN/OUT pairing (single segment deducts the shift break, multi-segment trusts break punches)
checked in and still inside a normal working window at ATTENDANCE_AS_OF: in progress, not a missing punch
arriving inside the grace window is not penalised when deciding full / half day

ATTENDANCE_ADJUSTMENTS.note: approved after the covering period was locked

PAYROLL_CALC.note: mid-period salary revision date (single revision per period supported)

STATUTORY_CALC.note: manual amount (finance computes slab tax externally) or optional flat-rate rule; full slab engine is a configurable extension

DASHBOARD_DATA.note: Payroll rows with missing attendance rows
